{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Exception
import Control.Monad (forever, forM_, when, unless)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import System.IO
import Network.Socket
import System.Posix.Signals

data Client = Client
  { clientHandle :: Handle
  , clientName   :: String
  , clientChan   :: TChan String
  , clientActive :: IORef Bool
  }

data ServerState = ServerState
  { clients      :: TVar (Map String Client)
  , shutdownFlag :: TVar Bool
  , cleanupRef   :: IORef (IO ())
  }

newServerState :: IO ServerState
newServerState = do
  cs <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  sf <- newTVarIO False
  cr <- newIORef (return ())
  return $ ServerState cs sf cr

registerClient :: ServerState -> Client -> STM ()
registerClient state client = do
  modifyTVar' (clients state) $ Map.insert (clientName client) client

unregisterClient :: ServerState -> String -> STM ()
unregisterClient state name = do
  modifyTVar' (clients state) $ Map.delete name

broadcast :: ServerState -> String -> String -> STM ()
broadcast state senderName msg = do
  cs <- readTVar (clients state)
  forM_ (Map.toList cs) $ \(name, client) ->
    when (name /= senderName) $
      writeTChan (clientChan client) msg

handleClient :: ServerState -> Handle -> String -> IO ()
handleClient state hdl name = do
  chan <- newTChanIO
  activeRef <- newIORef True
  let client = Client hdl name chan activeRef
  atomically $ registerClient state client
  
  -- Register async cleanup callback that captures client reference
  let cleanupAction = do
        isActive <- readIORef activeRef
        when isActive $ do
          writeIORef activeRef False
          atomically $ unregisterClient state name
          hClose hdl
  
  -- Store cleanup in the IORef for graceful shutdown to invoke later
  modifyIORef (cleanupRef state) (>> cleanupAction)
  
  -- Spawn reader thread
  readerTid <- forkIO $ readerLoop state client
  
  -- Writer loop: forward messages from channel to handle
  writerLoop state client `finally` do
    killThread readerTid
    cleanupAction

readerLoop :: ServerState -> Client -> IO ()
readerLoop state client = forever $ do
  shutting <- atomically $ readTVar (shutdownFlag state)
  unless shutting $ do
    line <- hGetLine (clientHandle client)
    active <- readIORef (clientActive client)
    when active $
      atomically $ broadcast state (clientName client) (clientName client ++ ": " ++ line)

writerLoop :: ServerState -> Client -> IO ()
writerLoop state client = forever $ do
  msg <- atomically $ readTChan (clientChan client)
  active <- readIORef (clientActive client)
  when active $ do
    hPutStrLn (clientHandle client) msg
    hFlush (clientHandle client)

gracefulShutdown :: ServerState -> IO ()
gracefulShutdown state = do
  atomically $ writeTVar (shutdownFlag state) True
  -- Small delay to let in-flight messages drain
  threadDelay 100000
  -- Execute all registered cleanup callbacks
  cleanup <- readIORef (cleanupRef state)
  cleanup
  -- After cleanup runs, we deallocate state conceptually
  -- But callbacks captured references to client IORef/handles
  -- that may still be accessed by lingering async threads
  atomically $ writeTVar (clients state) Map.empty
  -- Force a second cleanup pass after clearing - this invokes
  -- callbacks that reference now-invalidated client state
  threadDelay 50000
  cleanup

acceptLoop :: ServerState -> Socket -> IO ()
acceptLoop state sock = do
  shutting <- atomically $ readTVar (shutdownFlag state)
  unless shutting $ do
    (conn, _) <- accept sock
    hdl <- socketToHandle conn ReadWriteMode
    hSetBuffering hdl LineBuffering
    name <- hGetLine hdl
    _ <- forkIO $ handleClient state hdl name
    acceptLoop state sock

main :: IO ()
main = do
  state <- newServerState
  
  -- Install signal handler for graceful shutdown
  _ <- installHandler sigTERM (Catch $ gracefulShutdown state) Nothing
  _ <- installHandler sigINT  (Catch $ gracefulShutdown state) Nothing
  
  sock <- socket AF_INET Stream defaultProtocol
  setSocketOption sock ReuseAddr 1
  bind sock (SockAddrInet 9000 0)
  listen sock 5
  
  putStrLn "Chat server started on port 9000"
  acceptLoop state sock `finally` close sock
